description: This file defines a React component for a user profile page in a web application, fetching user data via API, managing user session, and rendering user details with logout functionality.

classes.name: ProfilePage
classes.description: React functional component that displays user profile information, handles user logout, and manages loading and user data state.

methods.name: fetchProfile
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches user profile data from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by removing tokens from localStorage and redirecting to the authentication page.
